title: Upload Bundle
description: Root envelope for a CiviDash data upload. Round-trip compatible with the JSON export.

generated_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when the bundle was generated. Informational only.

tenant.description: Optional tenant metadata. The tenant_id is always taken from the bearer token, not from this field.

locale.description: Informational only; translatable fields are provided as {de, en} objects in rows.

mode.description: upsert: create new, update existing. replace: additionally delete resources not present in the bundle.

fields.description: Export convention: lists columns populated in `data`. Ignored on import.

filter.description: Echo of export filter parameters (e.g. year range). Informational only.
